/.name: Home
/.title: Telning: picture books where your child chooses the ending
/.description: Wordless picture books for children aged 0–7 from Telning Publishing House. Your child colours the story, chooses the ending and talks about feelings with you.

/tada.name: The TADA way
/tada.title: TADA: talk about a picture book with your child | Telning
/tada.description: TADA is Telning's own way to turn a picture book into a real talk: Talk, Ask, Decide, Act. Built from research on shared reading and from clinical and behavioural work.

/guide.name: For grown-ups
/guide.title: How to read a picture book with your child | Telning
/guide.description: A short, practical guide to reading a Telning book together: what to do before you start, the four TADA steps, questions that work, tips by age and a free guide.

/send.name: Send Pim your ending
/send.title: Send Pim your child's ending, get a story card | Telning
/send.description: Take a photo of your child's drawing, fill in a short form, and Pim sends back a story card with ideas for your next talk. First name and age only, never a photo of a child.

/about.name: About us
/about.title: About us: the scientists behind Telning books
/about.description: Telning Publishing House is a small team of cognitive and behavioural scientists in Sweden. Meet the founder, see how a book is made, and read our promises to families.

/pim.name: Meet Pim
/pim.title: Meet Pim, the Telning character who asks: what would you do?
/pim.description: Pim is a small hedgehog with three stars on its head. Pim loves to listen, to wonder and to choose, and writes the letters and story cards that come from Telning.

/teachers.name: For teachers
/teachers.title: Wordless picture books for the classroom | Telning
/teachers.description: How teachers use Telning's wordless picture books: every child can join whatever language they speak at home, with TADA for the whole class, small groups or one-to-one.

/privacy.name: Privacy notice
/privacy.title: Privacy notice | Telning
/privacy.description: How Telning Publishing House handles data on this website, on the email list, and in the emails you send us. Plain words, no cookies, no trackers, and how to contact us.

/childrens-privacy.name: Children's privacy notice
/childrens-privacy.title: Children's privacy notice | Telning
/childrens-privacy.description: What we collect when a parent sends a drawing for a story card, why, how long we keep it, who processes it, your rights, and how to contact us. Written for parents.

/terms.name: Terms
/terms.title: Terms | Telning
/terms.description: The terms for using telning.com and the Telning story-card service, from WelloWork AB, the company behind Telning Publishing House. Short sections in plain English.

/404.name: Page not found
/404.title: Page not found | Telning
/404.description: Telning is under development and this address is not live yet. Go to the home page, read about the TADA way, or send Pim your child's ending for a story card.
